content: With memory prices still high and showing no signs of dropping, we’re always happy to find a good deal on a budget-friendly system with an adequate amount of RAM. Best Buy has the HP OmniBook X Flip discounted by $300, bringing the cost down to $699.99. This model is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 5 and 16GB of LPDDR5X memory, which should be great for both web browsing and homework, and a 512GB SSD for storage. The screen is a 1920 x 1200 LED touchscreen, with a fully rotating hinge for tented or tablet mode. [Product: HP OmniBook X Flip 2 in 1 | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fhp-omnibook-x-flip-2-in-1-14-2k-touchscreen-laptop-intel-core-ultra-5-226v-24-16gb-memory-512gb-ssd-copilot-pc-atmospheric-blue%2FJJGQJRKGTJ%2Fsku%2F6613868] While the Intel Core 5 Ultra may not be the most powerful chip for heavy workloads or gaming, the OmniBook makes up for it with strong battery life and connectivity. HP claims the system can run for over 22 hours of video playback on a single charge, and fast charging can take the battery to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. The laptops include two USB-C ports, one of which supports Thunderbolt 4, two USB-A ports, HDMI 2.1, and a 3.5mm headphone jack. Other deals to consider * The Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 are discounted to $189 (usually $229) at various retailers, including Amazon, Best Buy, and directly from the Google store, with the latter two also marking down the new olive color that was just introduced yesterday. These earbuds feature a smaller and lighter design than their predecessor, with excellent ANC and an improved transparency mode. Read our review. * Woot has an Anker 20,000mAh power bank on sale for $26.99 (usually $49.99). With up to 15W of charging power over USB-C and USB-A, you can keep your phone or other devices topped up for hours, and the display on the side lets you check the current charge level at a glance. * You can grab a DJI Osmo Pocket 3 at Best Buy for $399, a $40 break from the usual price. This compact video camera shoots surprisingly cinematic video, with a stabilized sensor and built-in LCD screen for keeping your framing dialed in. Read our hands-on.

chineseContent: 由于内存价格仍然很高并且没有下降的迹象，我们总是很高兴在预算友好且内存充足的系统上找到划算的价格。 Best Buy 将 HP OmniBook X Flip 打折 300 美元，将成本降至 699.99 美元。该型号配备了英特尔酷睿 Ultra 5 和 16GB LPDDR5X 内存，这对于网页浏览和家庭作业来说应该非常有用，以及用于存储的 512GB SSD。屏幕为 1920 x 1200 LED 触摸屏，带有可完全旋转的铰链，适用于帐篷或平板电脑模式。 [产品：HP OmniBook X Flip 2 合 1 | https://bestbuy.7tiv.net/c/482924/614286/10014?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bestbuy.com%2Fproduct%2Fhp-omnibook-x-flip-2-in-1-14-2k-t ouchscreen-笔记本电脑-英特尔-核心-ultra-5-226v-24-16gb-内存-512gb-ssd-copilot-pc-atmospheric-blue%2FJJGQJRKGTJ%2Fsku%2F6613868]虽然英特尔酷睿 5 Ultra 可能不是处理繁重工作负载或游戏的最强大芯片，但 OmniBook 凭借强大的电池寿命和连接能力弥补了这一不足。惠普声称，该系统一次充电可以运行超过 22 小时的视频播放时间，快速充电只需 30 分钟即可将电池电量充至 50%。这些笔记本电脑包括两个 USB-C 端口（其中一个支持 Thunderbolt 4）、两个 USB-A 端口、HDMI 2.1 和一个 3.5 毫米耳机插孔。其他值得考虑的优惠 * Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 在亚马逊、百思买等多家零售商处折扣至 189 美元（通常为 229 美元），并直接从 Google 商店购买，后两者还降低了昨天刚刚推出的新橄榄色。这些耳塞采用比前代产品更小、更轻的设计，具有出色的 ANC 和改进的透明模式。阅读我们的评论。 * Woot 有一款 Anker 20,000mAh 移动电源，售价 26.99 美元（通常为 49.99 美元）。通过 USB-C 提供高达 15W 的充电功率
